notablePrerequisites:
Radha and Savage Ventmaw do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Radha, Savage Ventmaw or Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Radha, Savage Ventmaw and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
